smoke_protocol.dataset: Frozen E014 train split only; 96 longest unique tokenized rows; frozen data hashes checked before output creation.
smoke_protocol.checkpoint_and_resume: Save complete step-3 Trainer checkpoint; exit; launch a fresh Python process; load/resume through step 6; validate optimizer, scheduler, RNG, adapter and trainer checkpoint files; require adapter weights to change.
operations_exercised: LoRA injection on the frozen seven target module names
TRL SFTTrainer forward and backward passes
finite adapter parameters and optimizer state
checkpoint save, fresh-process load and resume

engineering_only_deviations.warmup: 0 steps rather than the full-run 123; a six-step smoke is not the preregistered training schedule
engineering_only_deviations.evaluation: Validation/test are hash and split-audited but not passed to the trainer/evaluator; no benchmark, control, quality score or checkpoint selection.
engineering_only_deviations.output: Qualification-only directory; never E014 training outputs.

recorded_measurements: GPU name/architecture/HBM, ROCm, PyTorch, Python and pinned package versions
per-step duration and non-padding/padded token throughput
PyTorch peak allocated/reserved HBM and phase-end device memory
host RAM and process peak RSS
bitsandbytes quantization modules, NF4 quant type and nested state
optimizer class, adapter parameter count, finite-state checks and warnings

decision.if_exact_nf4_qlora_passes: Record CUDA-to-ROCm, kernel, allocator and telemetry as backend details; only call it CASE A after the complete pinned stack smoke passes. Do not start full training in this phase.
decision.if_nf4_qlora_fails_but_bf16_lora_is_chos: Keep E014 frozen; preregister a new experiment (candidate E016 after ID/index audit) before training.
decision.if_stack_is_unstable_or_requires_unpinne: Do not use it for the primary result; evaluate the NVIDIA profiles without treating this smoke as a model-quality result.
decision.if_amd_is_unusually_slow: Retain measured smoke evidence, estimate full-run duration from observed throughput with uncertainty, then compare costs before any full-run authorization.
